cache_url_download: cache a URL to a local directory and return the cached file path
cache_url_check_exists: check if a cached file exists and return its path without downloading
download_url_file: download a URL to a destination file path with a progress bar
download_url_custom_hook: download a URL with a custom progress hook callback function
review_io_module: review the pycls IO utilities module for URL caching and downloading functions
